ns2:course.label: Adv Topics in Econ Theory I
ns2:course.description: Study at an advanced level of one or more of the following possible topics: economics of externalities, advanced aggregate economic theory, theory of central planning, investment theory, consumer behavior theory, capital theory, welfare economics, inflation theory, income distribution theory, or other topics. May be repeated. Prerequisite: ECON 502 and ECON 503, or consent of instructor.
